pages.title: Two Blocks of Water
pages.text: Two water blocks make an endless source.$(br2)You never thought to question it. Dig a pit, pour two buckets, and draw as much as you need. The world has always worked that way.

pages.title: Through the Pearl
pages.text: Until you held an Ender Pearl to your eye.$(br2)Through its murky green, a faint current came from nowhere. It gathered where water was missing, turned along a repeating pattern, and became water.$(br2)Lower the pearl: only the familiar surface remained.

pages.title: The Patterns
pages.text: Later you saw it in flowing water, and again where fire vanished.$(br2)Different outcomes, the same current. Perhaps the patterns made the difference.$(br2)$(l)What if you could record them?$()
